div.span: No data for the current filters

div.label: Name
div.span: The title shown on the card. Example: "Revenue by month".

div.label: Model
div.span: The records to chart. Search by name or technical model (sale.report, account.move.line). Example: Contact for customers, Sales Order for revenue.
Click a field to add it fast: names become Group by, numbers become a Sum measure.

input.title: Arithmetic over other measures as a, b, c ...

label.title: Draw this measure as a line over the bars (combo chart) on its own right-hand axis.

div.span: What each bar or slice measures. Count = number of records; Sum of Amount = total revenue. Add a second measure to compare two numbers side by side. On a bar chart, tick "line" on a second measure to overlay it as a combo line.

div.label: Group by
div.span: The field whose values become your bars, slices or rows. Group by Country gives one bar per country. Drag a field here.

div.label: Sub group by
div.span: Splits each group into a second series. Country plus Stage stacks every country bar by stage.

div.label: Sort
div.span: Orders the groups. Value high to low puts the biggest bar first.

div.label: Sort by field
div.span: Order the groups by any field. E.g. sort countries by Created on, newest first.

div.label: Row limit
div.span: Max groups shown. 0 shows all; 5 keeps the top 5 (bucket the rest as "Others" in Advanced).

div.label: Period
div.span: Bucket size for a date group. Month gives one point per month (with year); Month across years folds every January together.

div.label: Date filter field
div.span: Which date the board date filter narrows for this widget. Auto picks a sensible one (e.g. Order Date).

div.label: Default date filter
div.span: Pre-scopes this widget to a range even when the board filter is off. This year always shows the current year.

div.label: Include archived records
div.span: Also count inactive / archived records. Off by default, so a chart of leads ignores archived ones.

div.label: Filter records

div.span: Match record(s)
Extra conditions on the data, on top of the model. Only customers: Customer Rank greater than 0. The count shows how many records match right now.

div.label: Content
div.span: The rich text shown in this block, e.g. a section title, notes, or instructions for the board.

div.label: Accent colour
div.span: The card's highlight colour. Tiles use it as their fill; charts use it for the first series.

div.label: Tile style
div.span: Tile look: Soft tint, Solid fill, or Outline. Soft suits most boards.

div.label: Value format
div.span: How numbers read. Compact turns 3,400,000 into 3.4M; Plain keeps every digit.

div.label: Slice labels
div.span: What each pie slice shows: the raw Value (e.g. 39), its Percentage (e.g. 28%), or nothing.

div.label: Target
div.span: A goal for this KPI. Target 100 with a value of 72 shows 72% of target on the bar.

div.label: Compare to
div.span: Adds an up/down trend badge. Previous period compares this month vs last month.
Toggles specific to this chart type. Semi circle turns a pie into a half gauge; Stacked piles a bar's series on top of each other.

div.label: Goal line (0 = none)
div.span: Draws a dashed reference line across the chart. Goal 100 marks where the target sits.
Paint a value by its size. Example: if Revenue is less than 0, colour the number red; the first matching rule wins.

div.p: Clicking a tile, bar, slice or point opens the exact records behind it - scoped to what was clicked, respecting record rules.

div.label: Running total
div.span: Each group adds to the ones before it - a climbing cumulative curve.

div.label: Fill empty periods
div.span: Insert zero rows for missing days/months so a time line never jumps a gap.

div.label: Group the rest as "Others"
div.span: With a row limit set, everything past it is summed into one honest Others slice instead of dropped.

div.label: Cap click-through to the row limit
div.span: Opening records from this widget shows at most the row-limit count, matching what the chart displays.

div.label: Item description

textarea.placeholder: Notes about this widget - shown on its info tooltip.

div.span: A short note explaining what this widget measures. Appears as an info tooltip on the card.

Dialog.title: 'Smart insights'
Dialog.div: Add some data widgets to get insights.

div.span: Narrative by your own key

div.div: You can view these settings but only the owner or a dashboard builder can change them.

div.label: Name
div.span: The dashboard's title, shown in the header and the switcher.

div.label: Colour palette
div.span: The colour ramp every chart on this board uses.

div.label: Density
div.span: Compact packs more widgets on screen; Comfortable gives them room.

div.label: Opens with date range
div.span: The date filter the board starts on. This month means it always opens scoped to the current month.

div.label: Auto refresh
div.span: Re-query every widget on a timer. "Every 5 minutes" keeps a wall board live without a reload. Manual = refresh only when you reopen.

div.label: Published (visible to the people below and to your groups)
div.span: Off = a private draft only you see. On = shared per the list below and any assigned groups.

div.label: Share with people
div.span: Type a name and click to add. These people can open this dashboard even while it is a draft.

div.label: Email a PDF digest on a schedule
Digest recipients
div.span: Who gets the scheduled PDF. Example: email the sales board to the team every Monday.

Dialog.title: 'Start from a template'
Dialog.div: No templates yet. Build a board and use "Save template".
